## Invitations

A total of 2276 people were invited to participate in the outreach activity. Attendance was 574, giving an attendance rate of 25.2. The figures provide a summary of invitations issued and participation recorded during the reporting period.

The attendance result will inform ongoing outreach work and support review of how invited people engage with the service. Staff should continue to record invitations and attendance consistently so that future activity can be monitored against this position.

## Contact

No SMS messages were sent to invitees; the recorded SMS figure was 0. The number of reminders issued was also 0.

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments. This contact remains part of the follow-up approach for people who were invited but did not attend. Any further contact should be recorded through the usual process, including whether the person was reached and whether additional support is required.
